blind.table_distance_name: stone wall segment with stained glass window
blind.description: A stylized architectural wall section built from warm tan/sandstone ashlar blocks, capped at the top with a rounded projecting coping stone. Centered within the wall is a narrow pointed Gothic arch window framed by stone molding, containing warm yellow and amber stained glass divided by dark diamond-lattice lead cames. The model has solid, clean surfaces on both faces and sits flat on the floor with no extra pedestal or ground slab.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangular bar with a subtle projecting molded lip along the top edge, colored light tan.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 times as tall as the figure (roughly 6.5 to 7 ft tall) and around 4 ft wide.
